name: Koreth
beschreibung: Gasthof Koreth is situated in the picturesque and historic district of Mühlau in Innsbruck, peacefully nestled at the base of the Nordkette range yet only minutes from the imperial Old Town. This heritage property pairs centuries-old Tyrolean tavern culture with modern hotel comforts. Tastefully styled guest rooms offer quiet relaxation with mountain views. The on-site restaurant and shaded outdoor dining garden are renowned for authentic Austrian and Tyrolean culinary classics. With easy access to the Hungerburg funicular and walking trails along the Inn River, it provides a perfect setting for culture and alpine city breaks.
kurzbeschreibung: Historic city guesthouse and hotel in the heritage district of Mühlau in Innsbruck at the foot of the Nordkette.
